<script>
    // Popup Logic
    const popupOverlay = document.getElementById('popup-overlay');
    const popupContainer = document.getElementById('popup-container');
    const closeButton = document.getElementById('popup-close');
    const minimizedBtn = document.getElementById('minimized-quote-btn');

    const showPopup = () => {
        if (popupOverlay) {
            popupOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
            setTimeout(() => popupOverlay.classList.add('active'), 10);
            if (minimizedBtn) {
                minimizedBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
    };

    const closePopup = () => {
        if (popupOverlay) {
            popupOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            setTimeout(() => {
                popupOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                if (minimizedBtn) {
                    minimizedBtn.style.display = 'flex';
                }
            }, 300);
        }
    };

    // Show popup after 60 seconds, only once per session
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem('popupShown')) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            showPopup();
            sessionStorage.setItem('popupShown', 'true');
        }, 60000); // 60 seconds
    }

    if(closeButton) closeButton.addEventListener('click', closePopup);
    if(minimizedBtn) minimizedBtn.addEventListener('click', showPopup);
    
    // Close popup if clicked outside the container
    if(popupOverlay) popupOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === popupOverlay) {
            closePopup();
        }
    });

    // Image error handler
    function handleImageError(element) {
        const svgPlaceholder = `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="h-full w-full bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 p-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="1" d="M4 16l4.586-4.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L16 16m-2-2l1.586-1.586a2 2 0 012.828 0L20 14m-6-6h.01M6 20h12a2 2 0 002-2V6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z" /></svg>`)}`;
        element.onerror = null; // Prevent infinite loops
        element.src = svgPlaceholder;
        element.classList.remove('object-cover');
        element.classList.add('object-contain'); // Better for showing the whole SVG icon
    }
    
    // Smooth animation for FAQ
    document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item details').forEach((detail) => {
        detail.addEventListener('toggle', function() {
            const content = this.querySelector('.faq-content');
            if (this.open) {
                const height = content.scrollHeight;
                content.style.maxHeight = height + 'px';
            } else {
                content.style.maxHeight = '0px';
            }
        });
    });

</script>
